title: Elevator controller
goal: Show an elevator controller with composite travel and door-cycle states.

rubric.must: A visible composite Moving state contains direction-selection, Going Up, and Going Down substates.
A visible composite Door Cycle state contains Opening, Open, and Closing substates.
A call visibly takes Idle into Moving, and a queued call visibly takes the controller from Door Cycle back to Moving.
Closing visibly returns to Open on an obstruction-detected transition.
Idle and Moving visibly lead to Emergency Stop, with reset acknowledged returning to Idle.
The initial marker visibly enters Idle.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the state exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows the requested Moving and Door Cycle composite states, traces the call, queued-call, obstruction, and emergency transitions, and shows the initial marker entering Idle. Labels and connectors are readable and traceable; no material overlap or cropping is visible.

items.evidence: Moving contains Selecting Direction, Going Up, and Going Down, with target-above/target-below transitions and floor-reached returns.
Door Cycle contains Opening, Open, and Closing, and its initial and final markers are visible.
Idle transitions to Moving on “call received”; Door Cycle returns to Moving on “queued call.”
A visible transition from Closing returns to Open, labeled “obstruction detected.”
Idle and Moving each lead to Emergency Stop on “emergency pressed”; “reset acknowledged” returns to Idle.
The initial marker above Idle has a visible arrow entering Idle.
